For visitors

Call the shop (508-473-7955) ahead, especially as daylight shortens. Bring lights.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Milford Bicycle Wednesday MTB Ride at Vietnam group ride

Milford Bicycle Wednesday MTB Ride at Vietnam is a mountain bike group ride in Milford, MA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Adams Street lot, Vietnam trails.

A social mountain bike ride on the NEMBA Vietnam trails in Milford and Holliston. The shop calls it a fun social ride with a great group. Seven Hills Wheelmen's listing puts the lot at 388 Adams St, Holliston.
